title: Daily order report returns HTTP 500 after SQL timeout
symptom: The report page loads, but generating the daily order report returns HTTP 500 after a SQL query timeout.
user_impact: Business users cannot generate the daily order report for the selected date range. Operational impact depends on whether the issue affects one report, one site, or all reporting users.
recent_changes: A reporting deployment was completed the previous evening.
A large sample data load for order history finished before the first report.

evidence.detail: User reports the daily order report fails for a large date range but the application menu still loads.
HTTP 500 observed on /reports/orders/daily after clicking Generate Report.
Sample log references correlation ID sample-corr-20260708-090500-sql001 and SQL timeout expired while executing stored procedure sample_sp_daily_order_report.
Smaller sample date range works; larger date range times out. No database writes or production queries were executed.

operator_notes: Sample-only SQL evidence scenario. Do not connect to real databases. Do not run write queries, update data, change indexes, kill sessions, or restart services.
